visual_asset_provenance.record_note: The current package does not include the original generation logs, exact prompts, model/tool receipts or third-party licence documents. The participant has confirmed that VIS-001–VIS-018 are participant-generated or AI-assisted conceptual visuals controlled by the participant and have public-submission rights for the competition submission, GitHub PR, Gallery, Proposal Page and A3/A0 PDF scope. Historical production details not retained are recorded as not retained; they do not change the confirmed submission-rights status. Each asset’s base-map and personal-data state is recorded below, and conceptual imagery is not treated as factual evidence.
